in_marathi.name: Pra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector, God, Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pra is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning protector, deity, or light. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is one of the primary deities, preserver of the universe. Pra is also a shortened form of Prahara, meaning half. The name Pra is associated with creation, knowledge, and the divine.
